integrity: All finite counts were reproduced using both a direct relational evaluator and an endpoint-constrained enumerator. Infinite statements are supported by proofs rather than extrapolation. No independent validation or absolute historical-priority certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification fixes a labelled linear intuitionistic preorder; it does not treat arbitrary partial orders, valuations, or modal validities. The exact endpoint sum is not asserted to have a simple closed-form recurrence. Finite verification reaches six worlds. General matrix-enumeration results might subsume part of the finding.
title: Endpoint classification and edge spectrum of four-way confluent finite intuitionistic chains
